purpose: Teach: 画質/長老/竿/無限/分子/頭文字/劇的/ラグビー

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お家のテレビの、絶対、画質、絶対、いいよね
lines.en: Mom, seriously — our TV at home has really good picture quality, doesn't it?
lines.style: Bright, rapid-fire delivery with genuine wonder. Leans forward slightly. Each phrase builds with innocent certainty, like he's just discovered something obvious that adults might have missed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんは、本気で、絶対、町内会の、絶対、長老、絶対、なのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Grandpa is actually a town council elder, you know, Sho.
lines.style: Gentle, almost musing tone. Slight pause before the name — she's looking at him with that particular warmth reserved for when a child has just made an unexpected connection. Quiet affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、釣り、絶対、竿、絶対、買いに行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I really want to go fishing with Dad and buy a new fishing rod.
lines.style: Urgent but not loud. The words tumble out with barely contained excitement. He's looking up at her, seeking permission and reassurance in the same breath. Slightly breathless.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 子供の好奇心は、本気で、絶対、無限、絶対、よね、翔くん
lines.en: Children's curiosity is truly endless, isn't it, Sho?
lines.style: Warm, reflective murmur — more to herself than to him, but including him in the thought. A soft smile in her voice. She's watching him with that tired-but-present exhaustion that says she wouldn't trade this for anything.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、理科で、絶対、分子、絶対、模型、絶対、作ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I made a molecule model in science class — look what I made!
lines.style: Quick, eager presentation. He's slightly breathless with pride, standing a little taller. The words come faster toward the end, eager for her reaction. Genuine, unguarded excitement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くんの、本気で、絶対、頭文字、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、同じね
lines.en: Your first initial is the same as your dad's, you know, Sho.
lines.style: Observational, connecting-the-dots tone. She's noticing something she hadn't quite articulated before. Soft, maternal — a moment of recognition that this child carries his father's name, his initial, maybe more of him than she'd realized.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、運動会の結果、絶対、劇的、絶対、に、絶対、よくなったよ
lines.en: My sports day performance got so much better this time, Mom!
lines.style: Bursting with pride, slightly breathless. He's delivering the news like it's the most important thing that's happened all week. Quick, triumphant energy — looking directly at her for acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、若い頃、絶対、ラグビー、絶対、選手、絶対、だったのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your dad was actually a rugby player when he was younger, Sho.
lines.style: Soft, knowing smile in her voice. She's revealing a piece of his father he might not know yet. Warm nostalgia mixed with present tenderness — speaking to him like he's ready to understand that his dad was once a young man too.
